# usdt-queue [-E test(seek)]
  cargo nextest run -p kithara-queue-tests --cargo-profile test-release --test queue --features client-wreq,kithara-queue-tests/usdt -E test(seek) -E test(/full_playthrough_census/)

# warp []

# workspace []
  cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude kithara-fuzz --exclude kithara-ui --exclude kithara-ui-gallery --exclude kithara-ui-input --exclude kithara-ui-shaping --exclude kithara-devtools --exclude xtask --exclude kithara-test-utils --exclude kithara-test-macros --exclude kithara-ffi-web-tests --exclude kithara-ffi-web-analysis-tests --cargo-profile test-release --features client-wreq,flash
